info.title: Shopvento Shop API
info.description: Public client surface derived from the bundled TypeScript wire contracts. The backend export was unavailable. Fields and optionality are preserved; backend-only formats, constraints, errors and authorization requirements cannot be inferred. Use the installation's contract for production validation. OAuth status and redirect shapes come from the component call sites. Cart and checkout clients exist; complete cart and checkout UI flows are not in this package.
